title: Quotation Template
description: Free GST quotation format for India with quote number, validity date, HSN/SAC, CGST/SGST/IGST, payment terms and customer acceptance. Use it in Word, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Excel or Overleaf.
features: Itemised table with HSN/SAC, GST rate and tax split
Validity date, payment, delivery and warranty terms
Customer acceptance and authorised signatory lines
research: All references show quote no., date and validity (7-30 days common), seller and buyer GSTIN, itemised lines with HSN/SAC and tax split, amount in words, payment/delivery/warranty terms and an acceptance signature.

blocks.heading: Terms and conditions
text: 1. **Validity:** prices are valid until the date above; after that they may change with material costs.
2. **Payment:** 50% advance with the purchase order, 40% on delivery, 10% after installation.
3. **Delivery:** within [3-4 weeks] of advance payment. Freight to site is included.
4. **Warranty:** laptops and monitors [3 years onsite, manufacturer]; setup work [90 days].
5. GST as applicable at the time of invoicing. Items not listed above are not included.
